proof:
intro z c d hz0 hdc
change (d : R p) • z = 1 ⊗ₜ[R p] c at hdc
have he := congrArg (qmul p M y v) hdc
rw [LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, hz0, smul_zero] at he
have hc : (c : ℂ) = 0 := by simpa only [qmul, LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul, Submodule.subtype_apply, one_smul] using he.symm
have hc0 : c = 0 := Subtype.ext hc
exact ⟨hc, by simpa only [hc0, TensorProduct.tmul_zero] using hdc⟩
